why: The canonical-prefix test, gone: an og:image on another origin, or on this origin without the /tanks/ subpath, is accepted, and a shared link fetches its card from a location this deploy does not serve. The page itself is unaffected, which is why issue #973 put the check ahead of the Pages deploy. With the test skipped the path is sliced off at the canonical length regardless, so the in-listing test still fires, but with the wrong message -- the case pins the message, which is what makes it see this.
